📊 Example Output
👔

Marcus Chen

Chief Information Officer
Enterprise Manufacturing • $2B Revenue • 8,000 Employees
Decision Maker Budget Authority

📝 Profile Overview

Marcus is a transformation-minded CIO at a mid-sized discrete manufacturer. He's been in the role for 4 years after rising through IT leadership. He reports directly to the CEO and sits on the executive committee, giving him visibility into business strategy—not just IT operations.

His company runs SAP ECC 6.0 with significant customizations built over 15 years. The 2027 end-of-support deadline is creating board-level pressure to modernize. He's evaluating RISE with SAP but is concerned about disruption to manufacturing operations during migration.

Marcus is technically sophisticated but business-outcome focused. He's tired of vendors leading with features. He wants to understand total cost of ownership, integration complexity, and realistic timelines. He's been burned before by implementations that ran over budget and disrupted operations.

"I don't need another cloud pitch. I need someone who understands that my MRP runs 24/7 and a botched cutover means $2M per day in lost production."

— Marcus, on what he needs from vendors

🎯 Strategic Goals

  • 📈 Modernize core systems before 2027 deadline
  • 🔗 Reduce integration complexity (currently 40+ systems)
  • 🤖 Enable AI/ML capabilities for predictive maintenance
  • 💰 Shift from CapEx to OpEx model for IT spending
  • 👥 Reduce reliance on aging ABAP developer talent

😰 Pain Points

  • ⚠️ ECC customizations create upgrade complexity
  • 🔧 IT team stretched thin supporting legacy systems
  • 📊 No single source of truth for operational data
  • ⏰ Board demanding faster decision-making capabilities
  • 🔒 Security compliance becoming more burdensome

🚫 Common Objections

  • 💸 "Our last SAP project ran 40% over budget"
  • 🏭 "We can't risk production downtime during cutover"
  • 👨‍💻 "We don't have the internal skills for S/4"
  • 🔄 "What about our 200+ custom transactions?"
  • 📅 "18 months is too long—we need faster time to value"

✅ What Success Looks Like

  • 🎯 Zero production disruption during migration
  • 📉 30% reduction in total IT cost over 5 years
  • ⚡ Real-time visibility into operations
  • 🚀 Platform ready for AI and automation
  • 😊 IT team excited about modern tech stack

📅 A Day in Marcus's Life

7:30 AM

Executive Dashboard Review

Checks overnight system alerts, reviews IT service metrics, scans industry news on Gartner and CIO.com

9:00 AM

Leadership Team Meeting

Presents IT roadmap update to CEO and CFO. Defends budget requests against competing priorities

11:00 AM

Vendor Demo (S/4HANA)

Third evaluation meeting. Focused on integration architecture and migration risk mitigation

2:00 PM

Security Review Board

Monthly compliance review. Discusses cloud security posture and audit findings

4:00 PM

1:1 with VP Engineering

Aligns on shop floor systems integration requirements. Discusses IoT pilot results

💬 How to Message to Marcus

✅ Do Say

  • "Let's walk through the total cost model together"
  • "Here's how a similar manufacturer handled their cutover"
  • "We can show you our integration architecture patterns"
  • "What would zero-downtime migration be worth to you?"
  • "Let's involve your VP Operations early"

❌ Don't Say

  • "S/4HANA is the future of ERP"
  • "Trust us, the migration will be smooth"
  • "Let me show you our roadmap through 2030"
  • "Other customers love our cloud platform"
  • "We can discuss integration later"

🎓 How to Use the Persona Development Skill

Use this skill in Joule to generate detailed personas like the example above—complete with psychographics, day-in-the-life, content preferences, and messaging guidance.

💬

Trigger Phrases

Say any of these to Joule:

  • "Build a persona for [role]"
  • "Who is the [title] buyer?"
  • "Create a buyer profile for [persona]"
  • "What does a [role] care about?"
  • "How do I message to a CIO?"
📝

Sample Prompt

Try this in Joule:

"Build a detailed persona for a CIO at an enterprise manufacturing company evaluating S/4HANA Cloud migration. Include their goals, pain points, common objections, a day-in-the-life, content preferences, and specific messaging do's and don'ts."
📊

What You'll Get

  • Profile Overview — Background, context, and motivations
  • Goals & Pains — What they're trying to achieve and obstacles
  • Objections — What pushback to expect and how to handle
  • Day in the Life — How they spend their time
  • Messaging Guide — What to say and what to avoid
💡

Pro Tips

  • Include industry — "CIO at manufacturing" beats just "CIO"
  • Add context — "evaluating S/4 migration" shapes the persona
  • Request messaging — "Include do's and don'ts"
  • Ask for content — "What content formats do they prefer?"
  • Iterate — "Now create the CFO persona for the same deal"
